_comment: Feats. prereq: level, attrs, feats, bab, resonance, kind. passive: aggregated modifiers (MAX keys use highest rank). action: special attack/ability granted. chain+rank: upgrade chains; the action bar shows the highest owned rank.

prof_melee.name: Melee Weapon Proficiency
prof_melee.desc: Use blades, batons, glaives and Lumen Edges without penalty.

prof_rifle.name: Long Arm Proficiency
prof_rifle.desc: Use carbines and rifles without penalty.

prof_armor_heavy.name: Heavy Armor Proficiency
prof_armor_heavy.desc: Wear heavy armor. Heavy armor blocks Resonance powers.

power_strike_1.name: Power Strike
power_strike_1.desc: A committed melee blow: -3 to attack, +5 damage. High damage, low accuracy.

flurry_1.name: Flurry
flurry_1.desc: One extra melee attack this round. All attacks -4, and your Defense is -4 until your next round.

flurry_2.name: Improved Flurry
flurry_2.desc: Extra attack at -2. Defense -2 until your next round.

critical_strike_1.name: Critical Strike
critical_strike_1.desc: Aim for weak points: doubles the weapon's threat range. Defense -2 until your next round.

critical_strike_2.name: Improved Critical Strike
critical_strike_2.desc: Triples the threat range and adds +1 to the critical multiplier.

power_shot_1.name: Power Shot
power_shot_1.desc: An overcharged shot: -3 to attack, +4 damage.

rapid_shot_1.name: Rapid Shot
rapid_shot_1.desc: One extra ranged attack this round. All shots -4, and your Defense is -4 until your next round.

rapid_shot_2.name: Improved Rapid Shot
rapid_shot_2.desc: Extra shot at -2. Defense -2 until your next round.

sniper_shot_1.name: Sniper Shot
sniper_shot_1.desc: A patient, aimed shot that doubles the weapon's threat range. -1 to attack.

sniper_shot_2.name: Improved Sniper Shot
sniper_shot_2.desc: Triples the threat range; +1 critical multiplier.

dueling.name: Dueling
dueling.desc: +1 attack and +2 Defense while wielding a single one-handed weapon with an empty off-hand.

bolt_deflection_1.name: Bolt Deflection
bolt_deflection_1.desc: While wielding a Lumen Edge, attempt to deflect each incoming energy bolt: d20 + 5 + DEX mod against the attack total.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.desc: +1 maximum health per level and +1 Fortitude.

sneak_attack_1.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack_1.desc: +1d6 damage against stunned, held, feared or unaware targets.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.desc: Medpacs and repair kits you use restore 50% more. +1 Medicine.

resonance_focus_1.name: Resonance Focus
resonance_focus_1.desc: +1 to the save DC of your powers.

resonance_focus_2.name: Resonance Mastery
resonance_focus_2.desc: +2 to the save DC of your powers.

covering_fire.name: Covering Fire
covering_fire.desc: Earned from Iona's trust. A suppressing shot: on a hit the target is Suppressed (-2 attack) for 2 rounds. 2-round cooldown.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.desc: Earned from Tav-7's trust. Overclock your chassis: +2 attack and +25% speed for 3 rounds. 5-round cooldown.

lattice_echo.name: Lattice Echo
lattice_echo.desc: Tav-7 carries a fragment of the WARDEN. Once per fight: every hostile machine within 8 m must pass a Will save (DC 14) or be stunned for 1 round.

resonance_sensitive.name: Resonance Sensitive
resonance_sensitive.desc: Iona's training awakens her latent Resonance. Grants a Resonance energy pool (12 + 2 per level).
